page: Microsoft Azure M96bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The server features 96 virtual CPUs mapped to 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The processor includes a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated mathematical and matrix operations.

In benchmark testing, the M96bs_v3 demonstrates top-tier memory performance, achieving a read-only cached memory bandwidth of 7448.22 GB/sec and an uncached write bandwidth of 184.37 GB/sec. Multi-core processing capabilities are strong, as evidenced by a multi-core Geekbench score of 20564.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 97408.44. The server also excels in database operations, recording 34584.01 on Passmark database tests and handling 114.5 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. Cryptographic performance is highly efficient, supported by hardware-accelerated AES and VAES instructions.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external premium block storage for data persistence. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the M96bs_v3 offers high resource density, combining a substantial memory footprint with high-frequency dedicated compute cores, making it a viable option for workloads requiring large memory allocations without the overhead of a GPU. It is highly suited for memory-intensive applications, large-scale database operations, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and memory-cached web serving.
